name: Tomasz Brzeziński
notes: 5 years of production Rust building low-latency order routing and market-data infrastructure at a high-frequency trading firm. Uses property-based tests (proptest) and cargo-fuzz on the order router. On Solana he has two merged PRs in an open-source Anchor lending protocol (a fix to interest accrual and its tests), but he hasn't shipped a Solana program of his own to mainnet. Good English, lives in Warsaw and is fine with 2 office days.
